A '''planetoid''' was located on the edge of the [[Vesla system/Legends|Vesla system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Originally a warm world. In c. [[3643 BBY]] a native [[Unidentified Vesla predator|predator]] [[Species/Legends|species]] began to suffer when the [[Sun Razer]] began to destroy the system's [[Star/Legends|star]] under the orders of [[Darth Mekhis]], and the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] agent [[Theron Shan]] constructed a [[spy ray]] on the [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] with the help of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ngani Zho]] and [[Teff'ith]].
